def parse_footnote_item(block: 'BlockParser', key: str, index: int, state:
    BlockState) ->Dict[str, Any]:
    ref = state.env.get('ref_footnotes')
    text = ref[key]
    
    # Remove leading spaces from continuation lines
    lines = text.splitlines()
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        # Strip up to 4 leading spaces (footnote indentation)
        if line.startswith('    '):
            line = line[4:]
        elif line.startswith('   '):
            line = line[3:]
        elif line.startswith('  '):
            line = line[2:]
        elif line.startswith(' '):
            line = line[1:]
        new_lines.append(line)
    text = '\n'.join(new_lines)
    
    # Parse paragraphs
    paragraphs = _PARAGRAPH_SPLIT.split(text.strip())
    children = []
    for para in paragraphs:
        para = para.strip()
        if para:
            child_state = BlockState()
            child_state.process(para)
            block.parse(child_state)
            children.extend(child_state.tokens)
    
    # Wrap last child in paragraph if needed
    if children and children[-1]['type'] != 'paragraph':
        children.append({'type': 'paragraph', 'children': [{'type': 'text', 'raw': ''}]})
    
    if not children:
        children = [{'type': 'paragraph', 'children': [{'type': 'text', 'raw': text.strip()}]}]
    
    return {
        'type': 'footnote_item',
        'children': children,
        'attrs': {'key': key, 'index': index},
    }
```
